blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran between Bombay (Bori Bunder) and Thane on 16 April 1853 covering a distance of 34 km.
Indian Railways was nationalised in 1951 and is currently divided into 19 operational zones.
Bholu the guard elephant, holding a lamp with a green light, is the official mascot of Indian Railways.
The Vivek Express holds the record for the longest route by distance in Indian Railways, running from Dibrugarh to Kanyakumari.
Darjeeling Himalayan Railway, Nilgiri Mountain Railway, and Kalka-Shimla Railway are designated UNESCO World Heritage sites.
